title: Non-current native NAS key set identifier

entities.name: Non-current native NAS key set identifier
entities.description: Information element indicating the non-current native NAS key set identifier included by the UE under specific conditions.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that includes the non-current native NAS key set identifier IE under specified conditions.

entities.name: UE has valid non-current native EPS security context
entities.description: Condition where the UE possesses a valid non-current native EPS security context.

entities.name: Inter-system change in EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode or N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change while in EMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: UE uses mapped EPS security context
entities.description: Condition where the UE uses a mapped EPS security context to protect the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for tracking area update procedure.

relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains the non-current native NAS key set identifier IE when specified conditions are met.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE has a valid non-current native EPS security context.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE performs an inter-system change in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE uses a mapped EPS security context to protect the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
The inter-system change condition requires the UE to be in EMM-CONNECTED state.
